CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_filament_transaction_sequence BEFORE INSERT ON filament_transaction WHEN NEW.sequence <> COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence)+1 FROM filament_transaction WHERE spool_id=NEW.spool_id),1) OR (NEW.sequence>1 AND (NEW.previous_effective_mg IS NOT (SELECT new_effective_mg FROM filament_transaction WHERE spool_id=NEW.spool_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1) OR NEW.previous_estimated_mg IS NOT (SELECT new_estimated_mg FROM filament_transaction WHERE spool_id=NEW.spool_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger.sequence_or_balance_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_filament_transaction_compensation BEFORE INSERT ON filament_transaction WHEN NEW.compensates_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filament_transaction WHERE id=NEW.compensates_transaction_id AND spool_id=NEW.spool_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger.compensation_spool_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_filament_transaction_decision_scope BEFORE INSERT ON filament_transaction WHEN NEW.decision_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumption_decision d JOIN material_usage_segment s ON s.id=d.material_usage_segment_id JOIN finalization_record f ON f.id=d.finalization_record_id WHERE d.id=NEW.decision_id AND s.spool_id=NEW.spool_id AND f.print_job_id=NEW.print_job_id AND (NEW.compensates_transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.delta_mg=-d.selected_weight_mg)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger.decision_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_consumption_decision_scope BEFORE INSERT ON consumption_decision WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_usage_segment s JOIN print_job_material m ON m.id=s.print_job_material_id JOIN finalization_record f ON f.print_job_id=m.print_job_id WHERE s.id=NEW.material_usage_segment_id AND f.id=NEW.finalization_record_id AND s.assignment_state='ASSIGNED' AND s.spool_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'decision.unresolved_or_wrong_job'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_consumption_evidence_scope BEFORE INSERT ON consumption_evidence WHEN NEW.segment_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_usage_segment WHERE id=NEW.segment_id AND print_job_material_id=NEW.print_job_material_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'evidence.segment_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_decision_evidence_scope BEFORE INSERT ON decision_evidence WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumption_decision d JOIN material_usage_segment s ON s.id=d.material_usage_segment_id JOIN consumption_evidence e ON e.print_job_material_id=s.print_job_material_id WHERE d.id=NEW.decision_id AND e.id=NEW.evidence_id AND (e.segment_id IS NULL OR e.segment_id=s.id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'decision.evidence_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_material_usage_segment_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON material_usage_segment WHEN NEW.assignment_state='ASSIGNED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM spool_mount a JOIN feed_slot slot ON slot.id=a.feed_slot_id JOIN material_feed_system sys ON sys.id=slot.feed_system_id JOIN print_job_material m ON m.id=NEW.print_job_material_id JOIN print_job j ON j.id=m.print_job_id WHERE a.id=NEW.spool_mount_id AND a.spool_id=NEW.spool_id AND a.feed_slot_id=NEW.feed_slot_id AND sys.printer_id=j.printer_id AND NEW.tool_index=m.tool_index AND NEW.started_at>=a.mounted_at AND (a.unmounted_at IS NULL OR (NEW.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.ended_at<=a.unmounted_at))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'segment.mount_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_spool_mount_overlap_insert BEFORE INSERT ON spool_mount WHEN (NEW.unmounted_at IS NULL OR NEW.unmounted_at>NEW.mounted_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM spool_mount x WHERE x.id<>NEW.id AND (x.spool_id=NEW.spool_id OR x.feed_slot_id=NEW.feed_slot_id) AND (x.unmounted_at IS NULL OR x.unmounted_at>x.mounted_at) AND (NEW.unmounted_at IS NULL OR x.mounted_at<NEW.unmounted_at) AND (x.unmounted_at IS NULL OR NEW.mounted_at<x.unmounted_at)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history.interval_overlap'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_material_usage_segment_overlap_insert BEFORE INSERT ON material_usage_segment WHEN (NEW.ended_at IS NULL OR NEW.ended_at>NEW.started_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_usage_segment x WHERE x.id<>NEW.id AND x.print_job_material_id=NEW.print_job_material_id AND (x.ended_at IS NULL OR x.ended_at>x.started_at) AND (NEW.ended_at IS NULL OR x.started_at<NEW.ended_at) AND (x.ended_at IS NULL OR NEW.started_at<x.ended_at)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history.interval_overlap'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_storage_location_cycle_insert BEFORE INSERT ON storage_location WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.id IN (WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS (SELECT NEW.parent_id UNION SELECT s.parent_id FROM storage_location s JOIN ancestors a ON s.id=a.id WHERE s.parent_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT id FROM ancestors) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'storage.cycle'); END
